summary: Frontend-only e2e test of the new generic 'Assign by attribute' bucket modal and the saved-value chips in the Bulk Specs & Filters modal on /admin/tiles. All 7 requested flows pass. Only one minor UX observation and no functional bugs.

issues: Modal preserves the previously-selected attribute across close/reopen (component stays mounted). If admin last used Finish, reopening keeps Finish selected instead of resetting to Colour. Not a blocker but the requirement stated 'Colour pill selected by default' — currently true only on the very first open in the session.
Any buckets typed but not saved are also preserved on reopen (setBuckets([]) only runs after successful Save, not on Cancel). Minor state-leak between sessions.

test_results.1_modal_opens_with_switcher: PASS — bar-assign-colours opens assign-colours-modal; assign-attribute-switcher renders 7 pills: Colour, Finish, Material, Size, Slip (slip_rating), Supplier, Suitability (from Tiles Manager Configure).
test_results.2_colour_suggestions: PASS — with Colour selected, bucket-suggestions block renders 13 chips (Beige, bianco, Black, Blue, crema, Green, Grey, Ivory, Oak, Red, Sand, White, white). Clicking a chip instantly creates a bucket of that name.
test_results.3_switch_to_finish: PASS — clicking assign-attr-finish pill: title changes to 'Assign Finish to 2 product(s)', buckets reset, suggestion chips repopulate with finish values (Aged Grey Oak, Aged Oak, Antique Brown Oak, Antique Colour Brushed Handscraped UV Lacquered, Matt, Polished, etc.).
test_results.4_end_to_end_assign_finish: PASS — created 'Matt' bucket, used move-to-bucket-{sku} dropdown for both SKUs (5445 and TEST-DRAFT-PO1), Save fired POST /api/supplier-sync/products/bulk-update-unified and returned success toast 'Assigned finish to 2 product(s) across 1 bucket(s)'. Persistence verified: reopened modal → switched to Finish → pool rows now show '(current: Matt)' for both SKUs. RESTORED: 5445 → Polished, TEST-DRAFT-PO1 → Matt (2-bucket save, success toast).
test_results.5_bulk_specs_chips: PASS — bulk-field-suggestions blocks render on 6 text-type filter rows (color, finish, material, size, slip_rating, supplier) + 6 spec rows (size, finish, material, color, slip_rating, suitability). Clicking value-chip-finish-0 ('Matt') fills the input AND auto-ticks bulk-field-check-finish. Sub-Categories rows correctly show NO chips (they render a tick-only 'Will add tag' hint).
test_results.6_auto_save_typed_value: PASS — typed 'ZZ Test Finish 99' into finish input (auto-ticked), clicked Apply → 'Applied 2 fields to 2 products' toast with Undo action. Clicked Undo → 'Undo complete — 2 products reverted' toast. Reopened Specs modal → 'ZZ Test Finish 99' appears in finish chip block (saved values listed FIRST, before alphabetical suggestions). Note: chip stays saved on the backend (expected — cleanup left as-is per task instructions).
test_results.7_colour_regression: PASS — modal opens, Colour bucket can be created (typed), Cancel closes with no errors and no error toasts. NB: on this reopen the active pill was Finish, not Colour (see design_issues #1) — no functional impact, just default-attr state persistence.

verification_data.attribute_values_endpoint_confirmed: GET /api/attribute-values returned finish + material + size values which populated chips correctly.
verification_data.auto_save_endpoint_confirmed: POST /api/attribute-values/save persisted 'ZZ Test Finish 99' — verified via next-open chip appearance.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor UX): reset attr state to COLOUR_ATTR and clear buckets when AssignColoursModal transitions open false→true, so each open starts consistent with the 'Colour selected by default' promise.
critical_code_review_comments: AssignColoursModal: attr/buckets/newColour state persists across close/reopen since parent keeps the modal mounted. Consider a useEffect on `open` to reset when the dialog opens (setAttr(COLOUR_ATTR); setBuckets([]); setNewColour(''); ). Non-blocking.

BulkSpecsFiltersModal.handleSave: the `savePromises` array is built but never awaited/collected (line 283-294) — attribute-values/save fetches are fire-and-forget which is fine, but the local `savePromises` var is dead code that could be removed for clarity.
Both modals fire attribute-values/save without error handling on non-2xx (silent catch). Acceptable for a UX save-history feature but consider console.warn to aid future debugging.
seed_data_creation: Left 'ZZ Test Finish 99' saved in attribute_values.finish list per task instruction ('fine to leave the preset value saved'). LP-1214 sale fields NOT touched. Restored SKUs 5445 (Polished) and TEST-DRAFT-PO1 (Matt) to their pre-test finish values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working. Any future changes to AssignColoursModal should re-verify: (a) attribute switcher pills render from ManagerPageShell attributeOptions (config.filter_facets + spec_fields), (b) bucket-suggestions repopulate on attr switch, (c) POST /api/supplier-sync/products/bulk-update-unified writes {[attr.key]: value} plus arrayField twin only for color, (d) POST /api/attribute-values/save is fired with used bucket names after Save.
